narrative.overview: SmritiRakshak is an operational workspace for developers building AI agents. Each memory is treated as an evidence record whose risk score, detector findings, and current disposition resolve into one legible decision spine. Soft sage grounds the workspace, warm near-white surfaces hold evidence, and deep forest green anchors primary actions and trusted states. Muted teal carries secondary emphasis and keyboard focus.
keyCharacteristics: A consistent risk, findings, and disposition hierarchy wherever a memory is inspected.
Data comes from live API responses; status and empty states remain explicit.
System sans is used for prose; tabular numerals and monospace are reserved for measurements and identifiers.

rules.name: The Named-State Rule
rules.body: Amber and coral communicate review or danger; never use them as decoration. Every colored state also has a readable label.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Type Rule
rules.body: Keep prose in the system sans; use monospace only for code, IDs, hashes, timestamps, and measured values.

dos: Do keep memory risk, findings, and disposition together when inspecting a record.
Do use live service responses and show explicit loading, error, empty, and disabled states.
Do reserve forest green, teal, amber, and coral for their defined functional roles.
Do keep a visible keyboard focus outline and support reduced motion.
donts: Don't use oversized metric cards or decorative threat charts in place of evidence.
Don't communicate a security state by color alone.
Don't apply monospace to ordinary prose or use glow, pure-black surfaces, or decorative gradients.
